treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of Ireland for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and Capital Gains (2003)
eif_quote: [Note: Convention in force April 12, 2005, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 139, page 2050.] | Art. 29(1)(a)(i): (i) in respect of tax withheld at the source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following that in which the Convention enters into force; and
source_title: Canada–Ireland Tax Convention Act, 2004, Schedule — consolidated, Justice Laws Website

rates.quote: (a) except in the case of dividends paid by a non-resident-owned investment corporation that is a resident of Canada, 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls directly or indirectly 10 per cent or more of the voting power in the company paying the dividends;
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude; having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: 5% tier threshold is 10% of the VOTING POWER, recorded as ownership_threshold; not available for dividends paid by a Canadian non-resident-owned investment corporation. MLI Art. 8 applies: Canada (no. 32) and Ireland (no. 11) both notified Art. 10(2)(a); from 2020-01-01 the holding must be met throughout a 365-day period. Art. 11(3): interest exempt at source on government debt, unrelated credit sales of equipment/merchandise/services, EDC/Irish export-credit-guaranteed loans, and to exempt pension organisations. Art. 12(3): copyright (excl. film/TV), computer software, patent and know-how royalties (excl. rental/franchise) taxable only in residence State: (b) royalties for the use of, or the right to use, computer software or any patent or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience (but not including any such royalty in connection with a rental or franchise agreement). Art. 10(6) branch tax max 5%. In Ireland the Convention has effect for years of assessment/financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2006.
